integrity_notes: Proof by exact logarithmic-ratio drift, absorbing upper bound, strict winner persistence, and telescoping sums. Finite checks corroborate only representative parameters. Priority risk remains for general competitive exclusion literature; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The claim assumes positive intrinsic log growth R, exact exchange symmetry, alpha>1 for exclusion, and strictly positive data off the diagonal. It does not treat asymmetric parameters, stochastic forcing, or survivor convergence to a unique scalar attractor.
title: Global competitive exclusion and a universal extinction exponent in symmetric Ricker competition
